home.title: One launcher for all your FNF mods
home.description: Browse GameBanana and Psych Online, install engines, and launch your favorite Friday Night Funkin' mods from one desktop app.
home.whatItDoesDesc: WeekBox brings the entire FNF mod ecosystem into a single app. Discover new mods on the Home feed, install them with one click, and let WeekBox handle engine assignment, archive extraction, and file organization automatically.

features.browseDesc: Discover featured and trending mods from GameBanana and Psych Online directly inside the app.
features.manageDesc: Install, update, and switch between Psych Engine, V-Slice, Codename Engine, P-Slice, FPS Plus, and Psych Online.
features.multiDesc: Native builds for Windows (x64), macOS (Intel + Apple Silicon), and Linux (x64, ARM64, ARMHF).
features.smartDesc: Parallel multi-part downloads with automatic retry, validation, and support for ZIP, 7z, and RAR archives.
features.oneclickDesc: Skip the hassle of manual downloads. Just press the 1-Click Install button on any GameBanana mod page, and WeekBox will automatically open, download, and set up the mod for you.
features.localizedDesc: Available in English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Indonesian, Turkish, and Chinese.
